question: Where can I get a list of wind projects currently in permitting in Germany, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: No single official dataset covers all wind permitting stages in Germany. The Bundesnetzagentur Marktstammdatenregister (MaStR) lists 8,808 pre-operational wind turbine units in status 'In Planung' (8,720 onshore, 88 offshore; 55.2 GW in total). Of these, 8,571 units have a permit identifier, with 4,843 distinct identifiers. Under § 5(4) MaStRV, registration is mandatory once a required federal permit is granted. Pending applications ('im Genehmigungsverfahren') are published as structured turbine data by 6 of 16 Länder (NRW, BB, SH, HE, northern RLP, SL; 3,249 pending turbines), mostly without developer names. EIA portals publish notices for larger cases.
main_caveats: Under § 5(4)-(5) MaStRV, wind units enter MaStR as 'In Planung' only within 1 month after BImSchG/WindSeeG permit notification; unapproved applications ('im Genehmigungsverfahren') are absent unless registered voluntarily.

MaStR counts turbines. Of 8,808 units in 'In Planung', 8,571 have a GenehmigungsMastrNummer (4,843 distinct identifiers). The other 237 lack that field. WindparkName is free text (2,833 distinct state/name pairs).
Capacity units vary across official sources: MaStR, NRW, SH, TH, RLP and BNetzA report kW (e.g. 5700 = 5.7 MW), whereas Brandenburg, Hessen, Saarland, Baden-Württemberg and EMODnet report MW.

No official onshore register separates 'authorised' from 'under construction' ('im Bau'); refusals, withdrawals and § 16b BImSchG repowering are structured only in NRW GenMon, Hessen (gvs.csv/klagen.csv) and RLP SGD Nord.

UVP-Verbund and UVP-Portal cover only EIA-mandatory (>=20 WEA or offshore) and EIA-screened (>=3 WEA) cases as HTML/PDF notices, missing 1-2 turbine simplified § 19 BImSchG applications without UVP screening.
answer.confidence_reason: Verified against MaStRV statutory text, live queries fetching all 8,808 MaStR 'In Planung' wind units, bulk XML schemas, all 16 Länder portals/WFS, UVP portals, BSH/EMODnet offshore WFS, BNetzA awards and Overpass.

attributes.note: Exact turbine coordinates in MaStR for all 8,699 permitted units >30 kW and in 8 Länder datasets; offshore polygons in EMODnet/BSH; parcel text in BNetzA awards and UVP PDFs.
attributes.gap_note: Pending BImSchG applications before permit grant have no statewide structured coordinate feed in 10 of 16 tested Länder (including Niedersachsen after Energieatlas shut down on 2026-10-31, and Sachsen iDA which returned HTTP 401), MaStR withholds coordinates for 109 planned units <=30 kW (§ 15(1) Nr. 1a MaStRV), and ~294 Landkreis-level portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: MaStR reports gross/net kW per permitted turbine (55,210 MW total); 8 Länder give turbine kW or MW; BNetzA XLSX gives awarded bid kW; EMODnet gives offshore project MW.
attributes.gap_note: Proposed MW for pending onshore BImSchG applications is unpublished at state level in 10 of 16 tested Länder (Sachsen iDA returned HTTP 401), requiring manual extraction from UVP-Verbund notices (which omit 1–2 turbine simplified § 19 BImSchG cases without UVP screening), and ~294 Landkreis-level portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: MaStR names legal-entity operators for 8,672 permitted units and BNetzA names tender bidders; among Länder datasets, only Brandenburg (BETREIBER) and NRW BürgEnG name developers.
attributes.gap_note: 7 of 8 open Länder permitting datasets (NRW GenMon, SH, HE, RLP, SL, TH, BW) and EMODnet omit applicant/developer names, MaStR masks 136 planned units registered by natural persons (§ 15(1) Nr. 2 MaStRV), Sachsen iDA returned HTTP 401, and ~294 Landkreis portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: 6 Länder separate pending vs approved turbines (NRW, HE, RLP also log refusals/withdrawals); MaStR flags permitted 'In Planung'; EMODnet, OSM and GEM separate 'construction'.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR merges authorised and under-construction turbines into 'In Planung', omits pending applications, and drops refused/withdrawn projects; 10 tested Länder publish no open statewide pending-application dataset (Sachsen iDA returned HTTP 401), none of the 8 Länder datasets separates 'im Bau', and ~294 Landkreis portals were only sampled.

attributes.note: MaStR bulk XML and detail pages give permit and application dates; NRW GenMon and HE gvs.csv give filing, permit, refusal and withdrawal dates; BB, SH and BW give permit dates.
attributes.gap_note: MaStR's JSON overview omits the permit grant date (available in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml); BB and SH leave pending 'im Gen.Verf.' rows undated; TH, SL and RLP SGD Nord WFS omit individual permit/application dates; Sachsen iDA returned HTTP 401 and ~294 Landkreis portals were only sampled.

sources.format: JSON API, CSV web export, and daily bulk XML ZIP (Gesamtdatenexport ~3.31 GB)
sources.adds: Single nationwide official register of permitted onshore and offshore wind turbine units ('In Planung') with exact WGS84 coordinates (>30 kW), kW capacity, legal-entity operator, wind farm name, permit ID/authority/reference, and (in bulk XML/detail view) permit grant and application dates.
sources.summary: Official federal register of all permitted pre-operational wind turbine units ('In Planung') in Germany via JSON API, CSV export and daily 3.31 GB XML dump.
sources.coverage_note: 8,808 'In Planung' wind turbine units (8,720 onshore, 88 offshore; 55,210 MW in total). Of those, 8,571 have a permit identifier (4,843 distinct identifiers).
caveats: Counts individual turbines (WEA) in kW, not wind farms in MW; group via GenehmigungsMastrNummer or WindparkName.
JSON API omits permit grant date (available in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml or unit detail pages); 'In Planung' does not separate 'im Bau'.

coverage.geographic: Germany nationwide (all 16 Länder onshore plus Exclusive Economic Zone / AWZ and territorial waters in North Sea and Baltic Sea)

unit.value: Individual electricity generation unit / wind turbine (Stromerzeugungseinheit / Windenergieanlage, SEE...); capacities Bruttoleistung and Nettonennleistung are in kilowatts (kW), hub height and rotor diameter in metres (m).
unit.quote: Bruttoleistung: Bruttoleistung in kW | Nettonennleistung: Nettonennleistung in kW

inclusion_rule.value: Grid-connected wind units requiring a permit under BImSchG (onshore >50 m total height per 4. BImSchV Nr. 1.6) or WindSeeG (offshore) must register as 'In Planung' within one month after notification of the granted permit; pre-permit registration is voluntary.
inclusion_rule.quote: Betreiber müssen ihre Projekte im Marktstammdatenregister gemäß Absatz 5 registrieren, wenn die Errichtung oder der Betrieb der Stromerzeugungseinheit einer Zulassung nach dem Bundes-Immissionsschutzgesetz, dem Windenergie-auf-See-Gesetz oder sonstigem Bundesrecht bedarf und die Zulassung erteilt wurde.

reference_date.value: Live JSON API queried on 2026-11-25; daily bulk XML archive Gesamtdatenexport_20261125_26.2.zip timestamped 2026-11-25 00:00:00.

update_frequency.value: Continuous live updates in the JSON/web portal; bulk XML Gesamtdatenexport regenerated nightly (typically around 05:00 CET) plus quarterly Stichtag snapshots.

exclusions.value: Does not systematically cover pending BImSchG/WindSeeG applications. Withholds street, parcel and coordinates for units <=30 kW (109 of 8,808 'In Planung' wind units) and masks natural-person operator names (136 units). Off-grid and military units are exempt. No § 16b BImSchG repowering flag exists in the schema.
exclusions.quote: Standortangaben zu Straße, Hausnummer, Flurstücksbezeichnungen und Geokoordinaten von Erzeugungseinheiten nach der Anlage Tabelle B bis E mit einer Leistung von höchstens 30 Kilowatt [...] Daten zu Marktakteuren nach der Anlage Tabelle A werden nicht veröffentlicht, wenn der Marktakteur eine natürliche Person ist

key_fields.meaning: Unique wind turbine unit ID (SEE...)
Lifecycle state: filter '31' = 'In Planung' (permitted, pre-commissioning)
'Windenergie an Land' (888, onshore) vs 'Windenergie auf See' (889, offshore)
Operator-chosen wind farm name (populated on 8,706/8,808 planned units; 2,833 distinct Bundesland+name pairs)
Permit object ID (SGE.../GEN...) grouping co-permitted turbines (populated on 8,571/8,808 units; 4,843 distinct permits)
Gross and net rated electrical capacity in kW (divide by 1,000 for MW)
Registered project operator/SPV name and actor ID (ABR...; masked for natural persons)
WGS84 decimal latitude/longitude and cadastral parcel (populated for all 8,699 units >30 kW)
Permitting authority and permit docket number
Permit grant date, application filing date, and statutory construction/operation deadline in bulk XML
Expected commissioning date (note spelling 'Inbetriebsnahme' with extra 's' in JSON API)

steps: For fast paginated JSON retrieval without downloading 3.31 GB, GET GetErweiterteOeffentlicheEinheitStromerzeugung with filter=Energieträger~eq~'2497'~and~Betriebs-Status~eq~'31' and pageSize=2500 across pages 1..4 (8,808 rows total; add ~and~Wind an Land oder auf See~eq~'888' for onshore or '889' for offshore).
Divide Bruttoleistung and Nettonennleistung by 1,000 to convert kW to MW, and parse Microsoft JSON timestamps '/Date(ms)/' as UTC epoch milliseconds.

To obtain exact permit grant dates (Datum), application dates (DatumDerAntragstellung) and permit-expiration deadlines (Frist) in bulk, scrape today's dynamically named Gesamtdatenexport_YYYYMMDD_*.zip URL from https://www.marktstammdatenregister.de/MaStR/Datendownload and join EinheitenWind.xml (EinheitBetriebsstatus='31') to EinheitenGenehmigung.xml on GenMastrNummer (and Marktakteure_*.xml on AnlagenbetreiberMastrNummer).

To aggregate individual wind turbines (SEE...) into wind farm projects, group primarily by GenehmigungsMastrNummer (4,843 permits; also inspect VerknuepfteEinheitenMaStRNummern in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml) and cross-check free-text WindparkName within the same Gemeinde/Landkreis.
reading_traps: Each row is one turbine. Of 8,808 'In Planung' rows, 8,571 have a GenehmigungsMastrNummer (4,843 distinct identifiers). WindparkName is unvalidated free text (2,833 distinct state/name pairs).
Bruttoleistung and Nettonennleistung are in kW, not MW (e.g., 5700.0 = 5.7 MW; total planned pipeline is 55,209.79 MW).

The JSON API returns GenehmigungRegistrierungsdatum (date the permit was entered in MaStR) and GeplantesInbetriebsnahmeDatum (note the extra 's' typo in the field name), but omits the actual permit grant date ('Datum der Erstgenehmigung'), which is only in EinheitenGenehmigung.xml (<Datum>) or on /MaStR/Einheit/Detail/IndexOeffentlich/{Id}.
'In Planung' mixes newly authorised turbines, projects awaiting EEG auction awards, turbines under active construction ('im Bau'), and stale/litigated permits not yet deactivated by operators.

2 of the 8,699 georeferenced 'In Planung' wind units have erroneous longitudes ~17.0-17.49°E in Poland instead of Germany (SEE999005545480 declared in Brandenburg at 52.659028, 17.492802; SEE970142364196 declared in Niedersachsen at 52.934261, 17.00854); validate coordinates against Bundesland polygons.
MaStR has no Repowering boolean or permit category: § 16b BImSchG repowering turbines appear indistinguishable from greenfield BImSchG permits.

evidence.claim: Mandatory MaStR registration for planned wind units applies only once the BImSchG or WindSeeG permit has been granted, within one month of permit notification.
evidence.quote: Die Registrierungen nach den Absätzen 3 und 4 müssen innerhalb eines Monats nach dem Eintreten des jeweiligen Ereignisses erfolgen. Für Registrierungen nach Absatz 4 Satz 1 ist das Ereignis die Bekanntgabe der Zulassung.

evidence.claim: Bulk XML export includes a dedicated EinheitenGenehmigung.xml file with permit type, grant date, authority, file reference, deadline, linked SEE unit IDs, and application date.
evidence.quote: 5.5.13 EinheitenGenehmigung Alle öffentlichen Daten der Genehmigungen. Rootelement: EinheitenGenehmigung Element: EinheitGenehmigung Dateiname: EinheitenGenehmigung.xml

steps: Fetch each Land's current export or WFS: NRW XLSX files from opengeodata.nrw.de/produkte/umwelt_klima/energie/ee/; BB wka.zip (both georeferenced wka.dbf and un-georeferenced dok/wka_og.dbf) from data.geobasis-bb.de; SH latest CSV via opendata.schleswig-holstein.de CKAN API; HE latest CSVs via DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20589039 (records 23557186 & 23596067); and WFS GetFeature for RLP SGD Nord, SL, TH and BW.

Harmonize CRS to WGS84 (EPSG:25832 in NRW/SH/HE/TH/BW/RLP, EPSG:25833 in BB, EPSG:31466 Gauß-Krüger in SL) and harmonize capacity units to MW (divide kW by 1,000 in NRW, SH, TH, RLP; keep MW as-is in BB, HE, SL, BW).
Group individual turbines into wind farms using BST_NR/BST_NAME (BB, SH), Standort_ID (NRW GenMon), ID prefix/NAME_WINDPARK (HE), or VERFAHRENS/NAMEN (SL).

In NRW, join or cross-check Anlagen-Genehmigungsmonitoring-NRW (which has pending/refused/withdrawn dates) spatially with NW-Vorhaben-nach-Buergerenergiegesetz (446 projects with Firmenname Betreiber) and MaStR.
reading_traps: Mixed capacity units across Länder: Brandenburg ('5.560'), Hessen, Saarland and Baden-Württemberg report MW, whereas NRW ('5700'), Schleswig-Holstein ('3200'), Thüringen ('6800.0') and RLP ('7200') report kW.
NRW XLSX stores dates as Excel 1900 serial integers (e.g. 46267) and in NW-Vorhaben-nach-Buergerenergiegesetz some hub heights lack decimals ('1666' for 166.6 m).
Brandenburg's wka.shp omits un-georeferenced planned turbines; read dok/wka_og.dbf inside wka.zip as well (8 additional turbines: 6 'im Gen.Verf.', 2 'vor Inbetriebnahme').

Rheinland-Pfalz WFS (ms:windenergieanlagen_an) covers only northern RLP (SGD Nord), leaves datum_antr and datum_gen empty on all 2,661 rows, and its OGC API Features path returns HTTP 401 while classic WFS GetFeature is open.

Hessen separates 191 'beklagte Anlage' (litigated decisions) from 'vor Inbetriebnahme': per metadaten.txt, 'beklagte Anlage' includes both third-party lawsuits against granted permits and applicant lawsuits against refusals; join gvs.csv and klagen.csv to separate them.

Baden-Württemberg's WFS is named Windkraft_Bestand ('existing stock') yet contains 239 'Anlagen genehmigt, nicht in Betrieb' turbines alongside 864 operational ones; conversely, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's LUNG WFS (wea) contains only operational turbines (all 1,829 rows carry INBETR_DAT or ALTANLAN_D).

problems: Sachsen iDA portal (umwelt.sachsen.de/umwelt/infosysteme/ida/) returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized to unauthenticated requests; RLP OGC API Features endpoint returned HTTP 401 (use classic MapServer WFS URL instead); Hamburg WFS de.hh.up:wka returned 0 features.

publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Operators must register wind units in MaStR within 1 month after BImSchG/WindSeeG permit notification (published openly except <=30 kW coordinates and natural-person names). Permitting authorities must publish EIA-screened/mandatory applications and permit decisions on UVP portals, and BNetzA must publish EEG/WindSeeG auction awards. Non-UVP simplified § 19 BImSchG pending applications have no federal publication mandate.
publication_obligation.frequency: Within 1 month of permit notification in MaStR (daily export update); event-driven per statutory milestone on UVP portals and BSH notices; quarterly for onshore EEG awards.

consolidated_republication.note: BNetzA's MaStR consolidates permitted wind turbines nationwide (post-approval), and UVP-Verbund / UVP-Portal consolidate EIA-relevant procedure notices across Länder and federal authorities, but no federal agency republishes all pending pre-approval BImSchG wind applications from the 16 Länder's LIS-A immissions-control databases.

checked_pages.saw: Nationwide daily XML and JSON API covering 8,808 'In Planung' wind units, of which 8,571 have a permit identifier. Section 5(4) MaStRV requires registration once a required federal permit is granted.
1,270 energy Zulassungsverfahren (4,441 total wind hits) as HTML/PDF procedure notices without structured tabular export or non-UVP 1-2 turbine cases.
2,080 federal/EEZ offshore and cross-border EIA procedure pages without downloadable structured capacity/stage tables.
Offshore wind project list PDF is frozen at Stand 19.12.2016; current BSH Planfeststellungsbeschlüsse are individual HTML/PDF notices and CONTIS Offshore-Windfarms-WFS returned HTTP 500.
Publishes monthly/annual aggregate permitted MW charts by Land and district from MaStR, not project-level lists.

national_registry.note: MaStR is the statutory national register. Among 8,808 wind units in 'In Planung', 8,571 have a permit identifier. Registration becomes mandatory after a required federal permit is granted under § 5(4) MaStRV. The status does not distinguish construction from permit approval and does not systematically cover pending, refused or withdrawn applications.

checked_pages.saw: Confirmed § 5 Abs. 4-5 MaStRV: mandatory project registration applies only once BImSchG or WindSeeG Zulassung has been granted.
Verified Betriebs-Status options ('In Planung', 'In Betrieb', 'Vorübergehend stillgelegt', 'Endgültig stillgelegt')—no 'im Genehmigungsverfahren', 'im Bau' or 'abgelehnt' status exists.
Document-based EIA notice portal across Länder; not a structured national inventory of all pending BImSchG wind applications.
Queried national INSPIRE/GDI-DE CSW catalogue: wind permitting WFS/downloads are published separately by individual Länder with heterogeneous schemas and no federal WFS aggregation.

if_unstructured.summary: To capture pending onshore BImSchG applications in the 10 Länder without open 'im Verfahren' tables, exact permit/application dates, and offshore AWZ Planfeststellung details, extract fields from official BImSchG public-display/permit PDFs (Bekanntmachungen and redacted Genehmigungsbescheide) and BSH Öffentliche Bekanntmachungen.
recipe: Collect new Bekanntmachung and Genehmigungsbescheid PDFs from UVP-Verbund, state Amtsblätter, and BSH Öffentliche Bekanntmachungen, and extract text with 'pdftotext -layout'.

From Section I ('Entscheidung') or the 1-2 page Bekanntmachung text, extract: (a) Antragstellerin / Vorhabenträger (developer), (b) procedure type (§ 4 BImSchG new permit, § 9 Vorbescheid, § 16a/16b type-change/repowering, or § 45 WindSeeG Planfeststellung), (c) turbine count × unit MW (e.g. 19 × 6.0 MW = 114.0 MW in G-10-2026-047; 14 × 7.2 MW = 100.8 MW in 40.104.00/24), and (d) both the application date ('Antrag vom ...') and decision date on page 1.

Extract the 'Standorte der WKA' coordinate table (typically Section II or Tabelle 1/2 in ETRS89/UTM Zone 32N or 33N, plus the WGS84 DMS aviation obstacle table in Condition IV); watch out for German thousand-separator dots in UTM metres ('471.800' = 471800 m Easting, whereas '261,00' uses a comma decimal).

Deduplicate multi-notice lifecycles by permit docket number (Aktenzeichen / Reg.-Nr.): a single wind farm emits an application notice, an EIA report upload, a permit notice, and sometimes a § 16b Abs. 7 BImSchG turbine-type amendment before construction.
if_unstructured.location_method: Full Genehmigungsbescheide and UVP-Kurzbeschreibungen include exact mast-centre UTM coordinates (EPSG:25832 or EPSG:25833) and WGS84 DMS aviation coordinates. Short 1-page Auslegungsbekanntmachungen (e.g. Temnitzquell G-10-2026-047) list only PLZ, Gemarkung, Flur and Flurstück—resolve those exact cadastral parcels via the respective Land ALKIS WFS/cadastre viewer.
if_unstructured.cross_with: Cross-check Aktenzeichen and parcel numbers against MaStR ('AktenzeichenGenehmigung' / 'GenehmigungsMastrNummer') within 30 days after permit grant, BNetzA quarterly EEG Zuschlagslisten, and OpenStreetMap 'power=construction' nodes for physical construction start.

where_published.name: Immissionsschutzbehörden der Länder — Öffentliche Bekanntmachungen & Genehmigungsbescheide nach § 10 BImSchG / § 21a 9. BImSchV
where_published.what: Official public notices of pending formal BImSchG wind farm applications (Auslegungsbekanntmachung) and full redacted BImSchG permit decisions (Genehmigungsbescheid) issued by Landesumweltämter, Bezirksregierungen, SGD Nord/Süd, Regierungspräsidien or Landkreise.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Filter by Bundesland and 'Zulassungsverfahren' or 'Negative Vorprüfungen' with 'Windkraftanlagen' / 'Windenergieanlagen' / '§ 16b BImSchG', or check each permitting authority's 'Öffentliche Bekanntmachungen Immissionsschutz' page and state Amtsblatt; download the Bekanntmachung PDF and, when posted, the redacted Genehmigungsbescheid ('GB ... geschwärzt.pdf').

where_published.name: BSH — Öffentliche Bekanntmachungen für Offshore-Windparks (§ 45 & § 73 WindSeeG)
where_published.what: Official BSH notices of public hearings, cross-border consultations, and Planfeststellungsbeschlüsse / Plangenehmigungen for offshore wind farms in the German North Sea and Baltic Sea EEZ.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Browse chronological notices on oeff-bekanntmachungen_node.html for 'Offshore-Windpark' and 'Planfeststellungsbeschluss' (also published in Nachrichten für Seefahrer); open each notice page for docket number, FEP site code, and decision date.
